name: Takagi Yukie
source:
Manahime's colleague and the school nurse. She runs the infirmary and manages the students' health.

Her gentle appearance and easygoing personality earn her strong support from both students and staff.

However, she isn't particularly serious. She is the only person Manahime, who has no friends among her colleagues, can call a friend.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/yajuu/yjch_y.html]official site[/url]]
